Excellent! The fix is complete and correct. The `_DoNothingAction` class now has an `__init__` method that sets `nargs=0`, which tells argparse that options using this action don't take any arguments.

This fix resolves the issue where `pylint mytest.py -v` was failing with "expected one argument" error, while `pylint mytest.py --verbose` was working correctly.
